subject: geography
title: Deforestation: Threat to the Forest
welcome_lead: Why is the Amazon shrinking? Discover the causes and impacts of deforestation, and what can be done.
meta_desc: KS3 Geography adventure on deforestation causes, impacts and solutions.
final_note: Brilliant! You can now discuss deforestation knowledgeably.

walkthroughs.body_html: Main causes: cattle ranching (70%+ of clearance), soya farming, logging, mining, and road-building.
Deforestation destroys biodiversity, harms indigenous people, and adds CO₂ to the atmosphere — speeding up climate change.
Solutions include protected areas, ecotourism, certified sustainable timber, and reforestation projects. Consumers can choose forest-friendly products.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between lateral, medial and terminal moraine?
options: Lateral moraine is the youngest and terminal moraine is the oldest.
Lateral moraine forms along the sides of a glacier from rockfall; medial moraine forms where two lateral moraines merge; terminal moraine marks the maximum extent at the snout.
Moraines are all the same thing — just piles of rocks.
A drainage basin is the underground source of a river.

A natural hazard is a physical event with potential to cause harm; it becomes a disaster only when it affects vulnerable people and causes significant impact.
